messages:
jason: Heads-up: RFC accepted to change streaming chunk envelope from 'chunk_end' to 'frame_end'. This breaks older SDKs. Need a deprecation/runway plan.
anika: Can we do opt-in header `X-RI-Compat: envelope=v1` for clients to request old behavior? Then remove in 6 months.
michael: I like opt-in. Need telemetry: count opt-ins per tenant + error spikes. Who owns metric?
katie: infra: I can add a proto metric `compat.envelope.opt_in` and tag by tenant_id. Also add alert if >1% error rate delta.
jason: Decisions: add opt-in header, support for 6 months, add telemetry, SDK patch to set header when user sets `compat: true`. Also add runtime fallback to translate frames if `Accept:compat-v1` present.
anika: We should avoid runtime per-request CPU cost. Maybe translation only in a dedicated 'compat worker' route and only for tenants with active opt-ins.
michael: Agree. Suggest routing rule: if header present OR tenant flag set, route to compat pool. No translation in main fast path.
katie: Compatibility pool can be medium priority instances with translation code. We should add a canary for 1% traffic first. Also plan feature flag `compat-envelopes` per tenant.
devex-bot: Reminder: update SDKs and add migration guide doc at /docs/migrations/envelope-v2. Notify customers via console banner.
jason: Timeline proposal: week 0: opt-in header + compat pool live + SDK patch. week 4: console banners + telemetry stable. week 12: start sunsetting w/ 30 day notice. week 24: remove.
anika: Fallback panic: add `X-RI-Panic: preserve-v1` feature toggle that operators can flip to route all affected tenants to compat pool if we see regression.
michael: Can the compat pool be autoscaled differently? we should avoid overprovisioning — use burstable nodes. infra: cost estimate?
katie: I'll model cost. Also we need a migration test harness: replay recorded traffic through compat translator and compare outputs.
jason: Docs: include code snippet for nginx header rewrite:

```
proxy_set_header X-RI-Compat "envelope=v1";
```

Also SDK example: `client.with_compat_envelope(true)`
anika: Good. Anything else?
michael: :thumbsup: I'll own the canary run. katie you get metrics. jason you coordinate docs & SDKs.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled for 3067891123 (in 24h) for tenant: 'beta-corp'
